subject: Renewal + Capacity Add: updated PO, billing contact & tax docs
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <procurements@apexdata.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity add — PO + billing contact?

Hi Monica,

We’re preparing the PO for our upcoming renewal and the capacity add (we’re adding 3 additional reserved nodes to the Dedicated pool). I attached our internal PO draft (Apex_PO_7896.pdf) — can you confirm who the invoice should be addressed to and whether we can request Net45 for this renewal?

Two specific asks from procurement:
- Confirm billing contact (we’d like invoices sent to QuickFinance Team <quickfinance@apexdata.com>).
- Provide Redwood’s W-9 and an updated invoice that reflects the capacity add and Net45 terms so we can route through our AP workflow.

Timeline: legal wants the signed PO and final invoice by EOD next Wednesday (5/22) to hit the June payment batch.

Thanks — looping in Carlos (ops) who will own the PO submission on our side.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Head of Procurement — Apex Data Systems
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Apex_PO_7896.pdf (application/pdf, 54 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <procurements@apexdata.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO + billing contact?

Hi Elena — thanks for the PO draft and the clear timeline. I can confirm a few things and outline next steps: 

1) Billing contact: we can invoice to QuickFinance <quickfinance@apexdata.com>. We’ll also keep the account owner (Vivek) in the loop for rollout coordination.

2) Net terms: Net45 is fine to request — I’ll route this to Finance for approval and to generate an updated invoice with Net45 reflected. Ben, can you confirm?

3) Tax docs / vendor onboarding: we’ll need either the completed W-9 or your EIN to complete our vendor record. If you attach the W-9 we can move faster.

4) Deliverable timeline: I’ll aim to return a Redwood-updated-invoice (PDF) and a DocuSign-ready order form for signing by 5/21 so you have one business day for legal to review before 5/22.

Next actions: 
- Elena: please attach W-9 + final PO when ready.
- Vivek: will confirm capacity scheduling with the infra team after PO is signed.
- Ben: please advise on Net45 approval and any AR notes (change of bill-to email).

Thanks — we’ll prioritize this.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0147

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO + billing contact?

Monica / team — quick notes from Finance:

- Net45 is approvable for this renewal given the existing ARR and on-contract commitment. I’ll mark the deal as Net45 in AR and generate the invoice showing Net45 payment terms.
- Required for onboarding: either a completed W-9 (for US entity) or a copy of tax registration for non-US entities. Also need the legal entity name and EIN exactly as listed on the PO.
- Once we receive the signed PO we’ll accept it and queue the invoice for the next billing run (target: 5/24 issuance to QuickFinance).

Neha, can you confirm whether we need any additional tax forms or certifications for Apex specifically?

Ben Carter
Sr. Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0133

From: Elena Ramos <procurements@apexdata.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@apexdata.com>
Date: Sun, 19 May 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO + billing contact?

Thanks, Monica and Ben — attaching the final PO and our W-9 as requested. A few clarifications included in the PO:
- Bill-to: Apex Data Systems, Attn: QuickFinance (quickfinance@apexdata.com)
- Legal entity / EIN: Apex Data Systems, EIN 12-3456789
- Capacity line: Dedicated reserved nodes x3 (term 12 months) — pricing line is in the PO.
- Requested payment terms: Net45

Attachments: Apex_PO_7896.pdf, W9_Apex.pdf

Please confirm once you’ve issued the updated invoice and we’ll route the PO to legal for signature.

Best,
Elena

Attachment: Apex_PO_7896.pdf (application/pdf, 58 KB)
Attachment: W9_Apex.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramos <procurements@apexdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity add — PO + billing contact? (Updated invoice attached)

Elena / Carlos — got everything, thank you. 

What we completed: 
- Finance (Ben) approved Net45 and we generated an updated invoice that shows: existing committed seats, the 3-node capacity add, and Net45 payment terms.
- Attached: redwood-updated-invoice-APR-2029.pdf (invoice number R-2029-1421). This version is addressed to Apex Data Systems — Bill To: QuickFinance <quickfinance@apexdata.com> and references PO #7896.
- Neha confirmed W-9 is sufficient for our vendor onboarding.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm that the invoice layout works for your AP team. If it’s good, sign the PO and return the fully executed PO to billing@redwood.ai.
2) Once we receive the signed PO we’ll schedule the capacity add (target: provisioning window the week of 6/3) and finalize billing activation.
3) For the DocuSign flow: I’ve generated an embedded signing link — here: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/sign/abc123 — use this if you prefer e-signature instead of a scanned PO.

Let me know if QuickFinance needs the invoice reissued as a CSV or with a separate billing code — Ben is on copy for AR workflows.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0147

Attachment: redwood-updated-invoice-APR-2029.pdf (application/pdf, 22 KB)
